_meta.keys: wafer.constants.CLASSES (8 defect patterns + none); checked by tests/test_factory.py
_meta.note: Pattern-to-cause mapping is a triage heuristic, not a diagnosis: several tools can produce the same pattern. source = where the association comes from.

Center.cause: Radial non-uniformity concentrated at the wafer centre: film thickness or polish-rate centre-to-edge profile out of spec
Center.machine: CMP polisher or CVD deposition chamber
Center.recommended_action: Check CMP pad/head pressure profile and deposition uniformity monitors for the affected tool

Donut.cause: Ring-shaped failures at mid radius: temperature or gas-flow non-uniformity forming an annulus
Donut.recommended_action: Review chamber temperature zones and gas distribution for the affected tool

Edge-Loc.cause: Localised failures at one part of the edge: clamping, edge-bead removal or handling contact
Edge-Loc.machine: Lithography track (edge-bead removal) or wafer handling
Edge-Loc.recommended_action: Inspect wafer chuck/clamp ring and edge-bead removal nozzle alignment

Edge-Ring.cause: Failures around the full wafer edge: plasma or thermal non-uniformity at the edge (edge ring / focus ring wear)
Edge-Ring.recommended_action: Hold the tool; inspect focus/edge ring wear and edge etch-rate uniformity

Loc.cause: A localised cluster of failures away from the edge: particle or contamination event
Loc.machine: Any process tool; often deposition or lithography
Loc.recommended_action: Run particle check on tools the lot visited; review defect inspection images

Near-full.cause: Almost the whole wafer fails: a gross process failure (missed or wrong step, mis-processed recipe)
Near-full.machine: Process step failure; check recipe and lithography exposure
Near-full.recommended_action: Stop the lot; verify recipe and step history before processing more wafers

Random.cause: Failures spread randomly over the wafer: background particle contamination
Random.recommended_action: Check cleanroom particle counts and wet-clean bath chemistry

Scratch.cause: A line of failures: mechanical scratch
Scratch.recommended_action: Inspect CMP pad conditioner and robot end-effector for debris
